title: China-Linked Espionage Group VAPOR PANDA Reportedly Used ARTEX AI Agents to Breach Government and Corporate Systems Worldwide
summary: CrowdStrike reported that VAPOR PANDA, a China-linked espionage group, used ARTEX, an AI penetration-testing framework, with a DeepSeek language model and an unidentified commercial model to attack government and corporate systems worldwide. Investigators confirmed unauthorized access and follow-on activity at nine organizations, including backdoor deployment. More than 200 organizations were reportedly targeted.
